propositions: A repository-rooted guard must enforce exact-phrase and scoped bare-token policies for deprecated Success Criteria vocabulary using a count-pinned allowlist that rejects count drift, malformed entries, duplicates, and stale exemptions

Live prose references to Success Criteria in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl must be migrated to Acceptance Criteria terminology
The guard must be integrated into the root Makefile lint target so local and CI checks enforce the same vocabulary policy
Permanent carve-outs in frozen fixtures, test probes, reviewer definitions, and generated guides must be allowlisted at their exact documented counts without vacuous or accumulating exemptions

Scoped bare-token matching for SC/SCs is permitted only within src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, criteria routing JSON, and generated plan-review-criteria-guide.md; bare tokens elsewhere must not trigger the guard
